name: The packing shift: five mornings
when: four cars on the board; a packing-shift fare has said the cold store wants a firm that turns up
offer: Eric Tharratt, cold stores. The packing shift met on time, five mornings running. Then he'll talk.

steps.verb: four cars meet the packing shift on time (by 06:00), five mornings in one game week

keys.how: through the dock gate, paying the Widow's tax
through the gate on a bluff or a push
round by Agar's cold-store road and the fish dock in the dark

pay.note: the contract: 40 pounds more a car a week (economy)

ledger: Eric Tharratt, cold stores. The packing shift met on time, five mornings running. Then he'll talk.
returns: the fifth morning, the gate swinging shut
